messages:
clare: Quick thread I'm proposing a small persistent "live sampling" pill in the heatmap header when sampling is active. Shows a dot + rate (e.g., "Live: 1 in 500") and a short privacy affordance. Prototype: https://www.figma.com/file/xxxxx/heatmap-sampling-pill tim: Love the visibility. Two immediate asks: (1) wording must be crystal about what is sent (no request bodies), (2) it must be dismissible for users who don't want the UI hint glued to the chart. rowan: Agree on dismissible. Also think we should include an opt-out link in the pill that opens a small modal for sampling settings. Tooltip alone is easy to miss on touch. maya: Accessibility notes: the pill needs to be keyboard reachable and announce changes via aria-live when rate updates (e.g., "Sampling rate changed to 1 in 500"). Also when dismissed respect reduced-motion. clare: Good call on aria-live. Draft snippet I put in Figma notes: ```
Live: 1 in 500
``` Thoughts? tim: role=status is fine for non-interrupting updates. But if the pill can be toggled it needs proper button semantics: aria-pressed and an accessible label. rowan: Copy suggestion for pill: short: "Live: 1 in 500" and tooltip/expanded modal copy: "Sends anonymized latency samples (no request bodies or PII). See privacy." Keep tooltip <140 chars. maya: Accessibility nit: contrast of the pill text when heatmap uses saturated reds/greens can fail. Add a subtle backdrop and ensure text meets 4.5:1. Also when using a dot indicator, provide a textual fallback for screen readers. clare: Will add backdrop token and a visually-hidden "Sampling active" label for screen readers. Also adding a small close (x) to allow dismissing for the session. Should dismissal be persisted per-user? tim: Product Q: persisting per-user seems fine. But if org disables telemetry, don't show pill at all. Product to confirm server flag. rowan: UX concern: if we let users dismiss the pill, they might forget sampling is on. Maybe show a quieter collapsed state after dismissal (small outline only) that expands on hover/focus. maya: That helps discoverability while respecting dismissal. For keyboard users, ensure Tab can still land on the collapsed outline to open settings. clare: Another feature ask from support: include an export action in the sampling settings so customers can download sampled timing summaries (aggregated, anonymized) as CSV for internal debugging. We should call out data retention and scope in the modal copy. tim: Good idea but legal needs to sign off. Also ensure export excludes any request identifiers. Add a firewall: exports only include aggregated buckets and no request-level rows. rowan: Visual microcopy inside modal: "Adjust sampling rate" header, body: "Sampling controls how many request timings we receive. Data is anonymized and excludes request bodies. Changing rate affects estimated monthly events: ~{estimate}." Footer: "Export aggregated timing summary (no PII)" button. maya: Tech accessibility: in modal, label the slider with aria-describedby referencing the estimate text. And if the export process takes >2s, announce progress via aria-live and ensure screen reader users get feedback when download is ready. clare: Performance note: pill should not cause layout shift when shown/hidden. Use translate/opacity and reserve space if collapsed to keep chart stable. tim: Copy tweak: replace "no PII" with "no PII or user content" to be explicit. Also prefer "latency samples" over "timings" to match p95 language. rowan: Final copy suggestion for tooltip: "Sends anonymized latency samples (no PII or request bodies). Sampling: 1 in 500. Adjust settings." Short label remains "Live: 1 in 500". maya: Accessibility final: include keyboard shortcut hint in modal: "Press 'L' to toggle live sampling pill when chart focused" and document in shortcuts modal. Ensure shortcut doesn't conflict with others.Žux-bot: Prototype updated: pill + collapsed outline state + modal flow added. Accessibility checklist added to frame notes. clare: Next steps: I'll update Figma with backdrop tokens, aria-live snippet, dismissed-state behavior, and export button copy. Tim/Rowan please confirm persistence and legal/export gating. Thanks!
